description: Create a new module in a course. Returns the created module, including its new Canvas ID. Each call creates a separate module — calling it twice with the same name makes two modules, not one — so check `list_modules` first if you want to avoid duplicates. New modules are always created unpublished, regardless of any other field; use `update_module` with `published: true` to make one visible to students. `prerequisite_module_ids` silently drops any ID that is not an existing module positioned before this one in the course — Canvas does not error on an invalid ID, it just ignores it. Once created, add content with `create_module_item`. Requires instructor/TA permission to manage course content.

position.description: Position of the module in the list

prerequisite_module_ids.description: IDs of modules that must be completed before this one

name: create_module
title: Create Module
